shared_elements: worked stone slab/monolith with rounded or domed top
anthropomorphic figure rendered in low relief/incision
circular or disc-like motif near the upper area
horizontal incised dividing lines/bands across the lower part
small repeated abstract signs or motifs filling the field
justification: Both are upright, roughly round-topped stone slabs carved with human forms, disc motifs and horizontal dividing lines across the lower field, which gives a generic family resemblance. But A is a massive, deeply modelled three-dimensional block dominated by one frontal figure in bold relief, while B is a thin, flat plaque with shallow, fine incision showing two figures in profile flanking a table above ruled bands of small signs — the compositional schemes and carving techniques are quite different.
